title: Change of name, address, or telephone number.
bodyText:
(a) Within thirty days of a legal name change, a program participant shall provide the program with a certified copy of a judgment, order, or any other documentation the program director deems to be sufficient evidence of the name change.

(b) Within ten days of a change in actual address or telephone number, a program participant shall notify the program of the change.
bodyHtml:
[§801G-5]  Change of name, address, or telephone number.  (a)  Within thirty days of a legal name change, a program participant shall provide the program with a certified copy of a judgment, order, or any other documentation the program director deems to be sufficient evidence of the name change.

     (b)  Within ten days of a change in actual address or telephone number, a program participant shall notify the program of the change. [L 2018, c 115, pt of §1]
